summary: RiffMaster chat retry + specific error-copy fix verified. All 9 new tests pass (tests 1-2 LIVE against real Gemini via public BASE_URL; tests 3-9 in-process via httpx.AsyncClient+ASGITransport with LlmChat.stream_message and asyncio.sleep monkeypatched). Verified: retry loop runs up to 3 attempts with 1s/2s exponential backoff, two warn-level attempt-failure logs fire, specific error copy returned per exception class (unavailable / rate-limit / safety / timeout / fallback), reply_text is always defined (no unbound-variable crash), tmp files cleaned up after video+audio+LLM failure, chat_messages/history never leaks MongoDB _id. Added /app/backend/tests/test_chat_retry.py (9 pytests, pytest-asyncio installed).

minor.issue: Operator precedence subtlety on line 723: `'rate' in lower and 'limit' in lower or '429' in msg` evaluates as `('rate' in lower and 'limit' in lower) or ('429' in msg)` — works for the current branches, but a bare '429' with no 'rate' keyword would be matched here BEFORE the unavailable branch (unavailable branch owns '503' already). Consider parenthesizing for clarity: `(('rate' in lower and 'limit' in lower) or '429' in msg)`.
FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated — use lifespan handlers (DeprecationWarning in test logs). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: parenthesize the rate-limit/429 branch in server.py:723 for readability.
Optional: migrate @app.on_event to lifespan handlers (not required by this fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Retry/backoff logic in chat_message handler is correct: 3 attempts, sleeps 1s then 2s between retries, catches BaseException-ish via `except Exception`, logs warn per attempt, logs error after all retries. Verified by assertions on sleep calls and caplog.
`reply_text = ''` is initialized before the try block so the finally cleanup path cannot hit UnboundLocalError. Outer except also sets a text reply so no 500 is returned to the client.
Tmp file cleanup in `finally` runs regardless of retry outcome; test 09 verifies no /tmp/riff_audio_* or /tmp/riff_video_* leftovers after a failing upload with both audio+video attachments.
seed_data_creation: Each in-process test creates/cleans up its own user + session_token in Mongo via an async fixture. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 was installed to support async in-process tests. Run with: `python -m pytest tests/test_chat_retry.py -v --asyncio-mode=auto`. Tests 1-2 require Gemini to be live; tests 3-9 are hermetic (mocked LLM + sleep).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is RE-TEST of a fix. No new bug surfaced. Fix is sound.
